notes: This snapshot contains the 77 current weapon records present in the extracted client WeaponBasicTable and matched one-for-one with the 77 weapon pages in the community catalog when checked.

The current roster contains five weapon types: Sword, Greatsword, Polearm, Handcannon, and Arts Unit. Rarity, weapon type, client identity, client ordering, and acquisition-source keys are preserved from structured client data.

English, Simplified Chinese, and Vietnamese names were selected independently by matching exact values at the same client localization key. Confidence is B because the complete multilingual evidence is an unofficial mirror of official client data rather than a first-party public weapon directory.
The official Homecoming notes independently confirm five weapons added in that version and the official Military Grade Issue notice confirms representative current 6-star names and types.

Hán-Việt names were generated character by character from the verified Simplified Chinese localization using the Thi Viện Hán-Nôm dictionary. Context-sensitive readings were selected only from alternatives returned by that dictionary. These are search aliases, not official Vietnamese localization, and have confidence E.
J.E.T. contains no Han characters, so it has no generated Hán-Việt alias.
No Chinese community, nickname, beta, or legacy alias is imported unless identity, usage, and status can be independently attested; this initial current-roster pass adds none.
thumbnail_source_url values are community presentation references only. They are not first-party name evidence or bundled module assets.
client_sort_id is preserved verbatim and is not unique: Golden Age and Farsight both use 76. catalog_index provides deterministic snapshot order without altering the client value.
